verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear top-to-bottom order of headline, body, CTA and legal. Its flaws: the logo and product are shrunk and float apart at the top, the SUNSET SALE ribbon is jammed under the AWARD WINNING pill in an untidy badge cluster, and the legal text is crammed beside the missing-asset box at the bottom edge. B has real collisions: the last body line ('sunset.') runs into the LIMITED EDITION pill, and the legal text and CTA crash into the missing-asset box. Its three badges stacked vertically also eat the middle of the layout, and the oversized ribbon takes attention away from the headline.
